title: Quadrocopter failsafe algorithm: recovery after propeller loss
summary: An ETH Zurich lab demonstration of a failsafe algorithm that lets a quadrocopter detect the loss of a propeller and recover, returning to its original position.
why: HN cites it to show that a quadcopter can keep flying after losing a rotor, though under ideal lab conditions.

quote.text: You're wrong about a quadcopter not being able to fly with 3 rotors, see this video
